The cream itself has a yellow tint and spreads over the skin with a matte effect, almost like a dimethicone primer (although it doesn't contain any!). Overall, I've been really enjoying this and plan to add it to my retinal faves.

I truly believe in the effectiveness of this product as it gives me the same benefits as prescription without the irritation. It leaves my skin smoother, brighter, and more youthful-looking. I have been on the hunt for a retinoid product that delivers results without the harsh side effects, and this retinaldehyde cream has been a game-changer. Retinaldehyde, being a precursor to retinoic acid, offers a gentler approach compared to traditional retinol, and this cream truly lives up to that reputation. I have sensitive skin, and I experienced no irritation, even during the initial adjustment period, which is where I usually show some redness and blotchy skin. The formulation is clearly designed with gentleness in mind. Despite its mild nature, I have been seeing improvements in my skin's texture and tone. Fine lines appear softened, and my complexion has a brighter, more even appearance. A big plus for me is that this cream doesn't leave a greasy residue even while it is absorbing. My overall impression is that the Avène Retrinal Multi-Corrective cream is practical, all the way down to the component. It has definitely earned a permanent spot in my routine! If you are new to retinoids and/or have sensitive skin I highly recommend this to you.
